# News18

> > News18 is India's leading news platform providing comprehensive coverage of state assembly elections, political parties, and election results across Maharashtra, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and other states.

News18 delivers real-time election data, winners lists, constituency-wise results, and analysis of major political parties including BJP, INC, NCP, AIMIM, and regional parties. The platform serves as a comprehensive resource for tracking assembly elections, exit polls, voter turnout, and political developments across Indian states.

## Key Topics

- Maharashtra Assembly Elections
- Jharkhand Elections
- Assembly Elections 2026
- BJP (Bharatiya Janata Party)
- INC (Indian National Congress)
- NCP (Nationalist Congress Party)
- West Bengal Politics
- Tamil Nadu Elections
- Kerala Assembly
- Election Results & Winners
- Political Party Performance
- Constituency-wise Data
- Exit Polls & Voter Turnout
- State Assembly Elections
- AIMIM & Regional Parties

## Election Results & Coverage

- [Assembly Elections 2026 in West Bengal, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Assam, and Puducherry](https://elections-v4.news18.com/): 2026 state assembly elections hub for West Bengal, Tamil Nadu & others
- [Maharashtra Assembly Election 2024 Result: Winners List - Winning Candidates & Parties](https://beta.news18.com/elections/assembly/maharashtra/all-winners-list/): Maharashtra 2024 election winners by constituency with party details
